title: Anthropic Set to Expand Pre-IPO Credit Facility
title_cn: Anthropic 将扩大首次公开募股前信贷额度
summary:
Anthropic PBC is set to finalize an expansion of its revolving credit facility to $15 billion, according to people familiar with the matter, clearing a hurdle before the artificial intelligence firm’s public filing for its highly anticipated IPO.

Morgan Stanley is leading the process, the people said. Goldman Sachs Group Inc. and JPMorgan Chase & Co. also have prominent roles on the facility, along with Citigroup Inc., they said. The four lenders are also leading the IPO, Bloomberg News has reported. The Claude chatbot maker is seeking to raise as much as SpaceX or more in the initial public offering, people familiar with the preparations have said. Companies typically finalize the revolver before they notify banks of their formal roles in a listing.

For more, we speak with Bailey Lipschultz, Senior Equities Reporter for Bloomberg News. (Source: Bloomberg)
